qualification: Within matched cases only; derived diagnostics, not a literature FoM, composite score or efficiency estimate. Case conditions remain in r8/r9 measurements.

definitions.relative_peak_reduction_pct: 100 * (baseline peak - variant peak) / baseline peak; negative is worse
definitions.raw_recovery_cycles: command switching frequency * finite saved-grid recovery time
definitions.raw_recovery_change_pct: 100 * (variant recovery - baseline recovery) / baseline recovery; positive is slower
definitions.source_VLOAD_port_work: Integral of VLOAD * Iup over the stated event window; positive current enters VLOAD
definitions.sink_VLOAD_port_work: Integral of VLOAD * Idn over the stated event window; positive current leaves VLOAD
definitions.net_assist_VLOAD_work: source port work minus sink port work; not complete assist loss
definitions.modeled_supply_event_energy_delta: variant minus baseline exact VI event energy at the modeled VIN and VDDC ports; includes main-loop and stored-energy changes; excludes unmodeled controller internal power
